Our Work

Presentations We're Proud Of.

A look at the venues, images, and gear behind the events we power — from intimate boardroom presentations to full main-stage conferences.

Venues

Spaces We've Served

Hotel Ballrooms

Large-format sound, LED video walls, and full stage rigs for ballroom keynotes, award galas, and multi-day conferences.

Conference Centers

Breakout room audio, main stage A/V, and coordinated live streams that connect in-room and remote audiences seamlessly.

Corporate Auditoriums

On-site town halls and all-hands presentations — clean sound, cameras, and live streams delivered on short timelines.

Outdoor Stages

Weather-ready PA systems, stage lighting, and streaming rigs for outdoor events, graduations, and open-air presentations.

Houses of Worship

Worship services, concerts, and community events — broadcast-quality sound, video, and live streaming for congregations of every size.

University & Academic Venues

Commencements, lecture series, and campus events — with ADA Compliance and reliability built into every setup.

Gear

State of the Art Equipment

We invest in professional-grade gear used at broadcast facilities and major event venues — because quality equipment is the foundation of a quality presentation.

PA & Speaker Systems

  • Point-source speakers for small to mid-size rooms
  • Delay and fill speakers
  • Subwoofers and monitor systems

Speakers & Microphones

  • Wireless handheld and lapel microphones
  • Podium and boundary microphones
  • Headset microphones for presenters
  • Digital wireless systems

Cameras & Video

  • PTZ and manned broadcast cameras
  • LED video walls — modular, any size
  • HD laser projectors
  • Video routers and switching systems

Live Streaming

  • Broadcast encoders with redundant failover
  • Multi-platform streaming (YouTube, Vimeo, custom RTMP)
  • CDN delivery infrastructure
  • Real-time stream monitoring

Staging & Structure

  • Modular staging platforms and risers
  • Podiums and lecterns
  • Pipe, drape, and truss systems
  • ADA-accessible ramp and stage configurations

Lighting

  • LED stage wash fixtures
  • Moving head lights and spotlights
  • DMX lighting control systems
  • Follow spots and gobo projectors
